name: Marit Maij - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the 2024 budget – assessing the implementation of the gender mainstreaming methodology in the EU budget
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its opinion on how the EU budget tracks spending that helps gender equality. It says the European Commission's current scoring method is too narrow: it cannot catch negative effects, indirect effects or effects on people facing overlapping forms of discrimination. It asks the Commission to build a fuller method for the next long-term budget, with spending targets, checks before laws are proposed, and gender-separated data.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission to design a better tracking method for the next long-term budget.
- **Who it affects:** The European Commission, which manages EU spending, and groups receiving EU funds.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to act on these requests during talks on the budget after 2027.
